title: FAI MCP Trust Manifest v1
description: Canonical schema for the FAI MCP federation trust manifest (`src/federation/trust.json` in npm-mcp; mirrored byte-identical to python-mcp + frootai.dev). Defines the 4 trust tiers + the seeded `knownPublishers` map + user `overrides`. Authority file for moat FM2 (the open, curated trust list).
$comment: License: CC0-1.0. Authored as part of Phase [M0.7] of the FAI MCP Federation Kernel masterplan. Doctrine principle 3 — NO HARD-CODED PUBLISHER LIST: this is the ONLY source of truth; the kernel never carries inline lists.

version.description: Major version of the trust manifest format. v2+ requires a migration helper per doctrine principle 8.

policies.description: Per-tier policy block. All 4 tiers MUST be present; no opt-out (else doctrine principle 2 — NO SILENT ATTACH — cannot be enforced).

knownPublishers.description: Map of publisher slug → trust tier. Maintained by the sister `02-marketplace-and-trust-masterplan.md` (each entry has an evidence file under `frootai/community-plugins/trust-evidence/<slug>/`).

overrides.description: User-attached + per-tenant additions, merged on top of `knownPublishers` at evaluator init. Shallow merge — user wins.

attachWithoutPrompt.description: If true, the kernel attaches without surfacing an MCP elicitation/prompt to the user.

allowDestructive.description: If true, downstream tools marked `destructive: true` in their MCP tool schema can run without per-call confirmation.

metering.description: Which usage-meter bucket the attach lands in (`azure-aoai` rolls up to the Azure AOAI MRR line; `per-publisher` rolls up per-publisher in the sister marketplace plan; `none` excludes from cost meters).

blockedAtAttach.description: If true, the attach is refused before transport spawn. Used by `untrusted` tier.
